## Overview

This directory contains comprehensive standards and implementation guidelines for MkDocs documentation sites within enterprise environments. These standards ensure consistent, maintainable, and professional documentation that integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and provides excellent user experience for both internal and external stakeholders.

MkDocs serves as the foundation for enterprise documentation sites, providing static site generation with markdown-based content management. These standards ensure consistent implementation across all enterprise documentation projects.

## Examples of MkDocs Standards

- Site configuration best practices including themes, plugins, and site structure
- Documentation writing guidelines, Markdown conventions, and content organization
- Material theme customization, CSS overrides, and brand consistency
- Essential plugins configuration and custom plugin development guidelines
- Performance optimization and accessibility compliance requirements
- CI/CD pipeline integration for automated documentation deployment
